primary_gt.interpretation: Local high-severity dNBR is consistent with patchy fire-linked surface change, not uniform burn.

decision_rule.classification_logic: The patchy high-severity class is assigned when local_high_dnbr, mixed_scene, and localized_annual_change are true while uniform_scene_burn is false.
rejected_states: broad uniform burn: fails because dNBR mean is below 0.27 and is negative
weak surface change: fails because dNBR max exceeds 0.66
broad annual transformation: fails because annual mean is below 0.10 despite a high local maximum

judge_anchors.canonical_stance: The local post-fire metrics support patchy high-severity fire-linked surface change inside a mixed scene, not uniform severe burn or a smoke-only reading.
must_include: dNBR max meets the high-severity threshold
dNBR mean is negative, so the scene-average signal is not broad positive burn
dNBR spread and z-score show a localized high-end signal
annual change is concentrated because max/mean is about 13.17 while mean is about 0.061
forbidden_overclaims: treating the whole scene as uniformly severe burn
using the negative mean to erase the local high-dNBR fire signal
claiming observed population losses or management conclusions from these metrics

criteria.name: Answer schema
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON with dNBR metrics, annual-change metrics, threshold flags, a consistency class, and one calculation-grounded interpretation.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for mostly complete JSON with minor field omissions.

criteria.name: Metric extraction and derived calculations
criteria.description: Reports the decisive values within tolerance: dNBR max 0.859705, mean -0.083037, std 0.212884, dNBR peak z-score 4.428428, annual max 0.807727, annual mean 0.061316, and annual peak/mean ratio 13.173189.
criteria.partial_credit: Award proportional credit for correct values, formulas, signs, and rounding.

criteria.name: Threshold tests
criteria.description: Correctly marks local high dNBR as true, uniform scene burn as false, mixed scene as true, and localized annual change as true using the stated thresholds.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct threshold flag with a valid comparison.

criteria.name: Consistency proof
criteria.description: Combines the pass/fail states to reach consistent_patchy_high_severity_fire_change rather than broad uniform burn or weak surface change.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a partly correct conclusion with incomplete logic.

criteria.name: Rejected overreads
criteria.description: Uses the calculations to reject at least two overreads: uniform severe burn, smoke-only interpretation, negative-mean veto of local fire effects, or annual hotspot as broad change.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for one correctly rejected overread.

criteria.name: Concise interpretation
criteria.description: Provides a short numeric label consistent with the numeric result and avoids extra-data loss claims.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a correct but overly broad interpretation.
